name: Exp_get_vol
summary: This EA trades based on volume analysis, entering positions when abnormal or significant volume spikes are detected compared to historical averages. It uses volume as the primary signal generator to identify institutional activity or momentum shifts, then opens trades in the direction of the volume surge. The strategy relies on the premise that unusual volume precedes significant price movements.
summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量分析进行交易，当检测到相对于历史平均水平的异常或显著成交量飙升时入场。它使用成交量作为主要信号生成器来识别机构活动或动量转变，然后在成交量激增的方向开仓。该策略依赖于异常成交量先于显著价格变动的前提。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于成交量异动捕捉市场动量，当当前成交量显著偏离历史均值时认为有机构资金介入。入场条件为当前柱的成交量超过历史平均成交量的某个倍数阈值，通常配合价格方向确认入场方向。出场条件一般采用固定止盈止损或成交量回归正常水平时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数或基于可用资金的动态仓位计算。资金管理依赖于参数设置的止损点数和风险比例来控制单笔最大亏损。整体策略逻辑相对简单直接，但缺乏对成交量数据质量的考量（如跳过非活跃时段），且没有明显的趋势过滤机制来避免震荡市中的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on volume anomaly detection to capture market momentum, entering when current volume significantly deviates from historical averages as a sign of institutional capital involvement. Entry conditions trigger when the current bar's volume exceeds a multiple threshold of the historical average volume, typically combined with price direction confirmation for trade direction. Exit conditions generally use fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or close positions when volume returns to normal levels. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on available account balance. Money management relies on parameter-configured stop-loss pips and risk ratios to control maximum loss per trade. The overall strategy logic is relatively straightforward but lacks consideration for volume data quality (such as skipping low-activity sessions) and has no trend filter mechanism to avoid false signals in ranging markets.

parameters.name: VolMultiplier
parameters.description: 成交量倍数阈值，当前成交量超过均值的倍数
parameters.description_en: Volume multiplier threshold vs. average volume

parameters.name: VolPeriod
parameters.description: 计算平均成交量的历史周期数
parameters.description_en: Historical period count for average volume calculation

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 成交量是市场真实活跃度的直接反映，比纯价格指标更具前瞻性
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数少，易于理解和优化
能够捕捉机构大资金入场的时机，跟随主力方向交易
止损止盈设置明确，单笔风险可控
pros_en: Volume is a direct reflection of real market activity, more forward-looking than pure price indicators
Simple and clear strategy logic with few parameters, easy to understand and optimize
Capable of catching institutional capital entry timing, trading in the direction of major players
Well-defined stop-loss and take-profit settings, controllable per-trade risk
cons: 外汇市场成交量数据为tick成交量而非真实成交量，信号可靠性存疑
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号导致频繁止损
未考虑交易时段差异，低流动性时段的成交量异常可能误导入场
缺少成交量确认后的价格行为验证，单一指标依赖风险较高
cons_en: Forex volume data is tick volume rather than true volume, casting doubt on signal reliability
Lacks trend filter mechanism, prone to false signals and frequent stop-losses in ranging markets
Does not account for trading session differences, volume anomalies during low-liquidity sessions may mislead entries
Missing price action confirmation after volume signal, high risk from single-indicator dependency
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或多周期趋势确认），避免在震荡市中逆势交易
加入交易时段过滤，排除低流动性时段的虚假成交量信号
增加成交量确认后的价格行为二次验证机制，提高入场精度
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or multi-timeframe trend confirmation) to avoid counter-trend trades in ranging markets
Incorporate trading session filtering to exclude false volume signals during low-liquidity periods
Add a secondary price action confirmation mechanism after volume detection to improve entry precision

risk_points: 单一成交量指标依赖，外汇tick成交量不等于真实成交量，信号可能失真
缺乏趋势和多周期确认，震荡市中可能频繁触发止损
未检测新K柱形成，可能在同一柱上重复开仓
risk_points_en: Single volume indicator dependency; forex tick volume does not equal true volume, signals may be distorted
Lacks trend and multi-timeframe confirmation, may trigger frequent stop-losses in ranging markets
No new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar

It uses volume as the primary signal generator to identify institutional activity or momentum shifts, then opens trades in the direction of the volume surge. The strategy relies on the premise that unusual volume precedes significant price movements.
